info.title: Grail Protocol
info.summary: Graph routed exchange of envelopes between participants, with causality, provenance, and scope isolation.

get.summary: Reads a graph at its current revision.
Reads an envelope and its lifecycle.
Reads the causal ancestry of an envelope.

post.summary: Erases an envelope's payload, keeping its digest and link.

get.summary: Reads deliveries for a participant after a cursor, acknowledging everything up to it, waiting up to `wait` milliseconds for one to arrive.
Reads what was posted to a channel after a cursor without acknowledging anything, waiting up to `wait` milliseconds for a post to arrive. Only the owner and the channel's subscribers may read it.

200.description: A page of the channel's posts.

get.summary: Reads a range of ledger entries with their links.

post.summary: Issues a narrower token to another participant.
Revokes a token and every token delegated from it.
Carries one JSON-RPC message from the token's participant to a tool participant.
Exports a participant's working context as a sealed, portable handoff.

put.summary: Imports a handoff from another fabric after checking its integrity.

get.summary: Reads a handoff this scope exported or imported.

post.summary: Checks a handoff's integrity and whether this fabric sealed it.

get.summary: Lists the secrets of the token's graphs: names, versions, and policy, never values.

put.summary: Gives a secret to the fabric's custody, or rotates it to a new version.

201.description: The held secret, without its value.

delete.summary: Destroys a held secret; references to it stop resolving at once.

Kind.description: A reserved kind, or an extension kind starting with x-.

Token.description: The claims of a capability token. On the wire a token is the unpadded base64url of these claims' canonical form, a dot, and the unpadded base64url of its signature.

Origin.description: Where a handoff was exported: the exporting fabric's configured name and the address the agent held there.

HandoffRequest.description: What to carry: the anchor transfers whose causal ancestry travels with the agent.

expires.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch; at most handoffLifetimeMillis after issue. Defaults to that bound.

HandoffEntry.description: One ledger entry of the origin. `envelope` is the digested body; it is absent when withheld and has no payload when erased.

Handoff.description: A portable, self-verifying record of an agent's working context, carried from one fabric to another.

digest.description: sha256 of the canonical handoff without digest and seal.

seal.description: The origin fabric's attestation of the digest; only the origin can check it.

needs.description: The secret names the carried envelopes reference. Values never travel; the receiving owner binds its own.

SecretReference.description: Stands for a held secret anywhere inside a payload. The fabric replaces it with the value only in deliveries to the secret's audience; everywhere else it stays a reference.

SecretDeposit.description: A secret given to the fabric's custody. The value can never be read back.

audience.description: The tool or service participants whose deliveries receive the value. Agents, people, memory, and graphs are refused.

senders.description: The participants that may reference the secret; empty means any participant of the graph.

kinds.description: The envelope kinds that may carry a reference; empty means any.

uses.description: How many admitted envelopes may reference it before it is spent.

SecretView.description: What anyone allowed to see a secret's existence may know about it. Never the value.

reveals.description: How many deliveries have held the value of this version.

revealed.description: When a delivery last held the value.
